messages:
ela: flagging PR 4398  broken cross-ref from troubleshooting 429s -> node retry snippet. can someone pick up a micro fix?

noah: I can handle the links. which file?

ela: docs/runbooks/429-timeouts.md links to /snippets/node/retries.md#old-api which 404s after the snippet rename.

jin: I renamed the snippet recently when updating the SDK. I'll add a compat anchor and a short migration note.

docsbot: link-checker: 1 failed anchor in docs/runbooks/429-timeouts.md (job id 9932).

noah: plan: add heading id {#old-api} and update the runbook link to point to the new path plus alias. tiny PR.

ela: also please include a short example showing old -> new call patterns and mark the legacy example with a deprecation banner.

jin: adding this to my branch jin/snippet-compat-4398. snippet example: ```js
// legacy
await client.retry.generate(prompt, { maxRetries: 1 })
// new
await client.request.generate({ prompt, retries: { maxAttempts: 1 } })
```
I'll keep legacy example for 2 weeks.

noah: PR opened for anchors: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4399. requesting review from @ela.

docsbot: CI queued: docs-link-checker, snippets-playground.

ela: quick QA after both PRs merge: run link-checker and playground snippets job. if green I'll merge.

jin: done, pushed mapping table and deprecation note. linking PRs in comments.

noah: merged anchor PR, link-checker now passes locally. waiting on snippets-playground.

docsbot: notify: PR 4398 updated, labels: docs, 429, snippet-compat. CI status: pending.

ela: perfect. thanks folks. will merge once CI passes.
